passage.label: Hour come near moon split; see miracle turn away say passing magic; denied followed inclinations every matter settlement; already come information deterrence; extensive wisdom warning not avail; leave them Day Caller calls something forbidding; eyes humbled emerge graves locusts spreading; racing ahead toward Caller disbelievers say difficult Day; people Noah denied before denied servant said madman repelled; invoked Lord overpowered help; opened gates heaven rain pouring; earth burst springs waters met predestined; carried him planks nails; sailing under observation reward denied; left sign will remember; how severe punishment warning; made Quran easy remembrance will remember

arabicExcerpts.text: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرٞ مُّسۡتَمِرّٞ
وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرٖ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ
فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ نُّكُرٍ
خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادٞ مُّنتَشِرٞ
مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرٞ
۞كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونٞ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ
وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونٗا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرٖ قَدۡ قُدِرَ
تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءٗ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةٗ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ

mainSubject.label: The Hour's nearness declared alongside the moon-splitting sign; miracles dismissed as passing magic while denial follows inclination, yet every matter has its appointed settlement; deterrent information and extensive wisdom having arrived but warning proving unavailing; the Prophet told to leave them until the Day the Caller summons to something forbidding, when humbled eyes emerge from graves like spreading locusts racing toward the Caller and disbelievers name it a difficult Day; Noah's people denying and repelling the servant called madman; his invocation answered by heaven's rain-gates and earth's bursting springs meeting for a predestined matter; carried on plank-and-nail construction sailing under divine observation as reward for the denied one; left as a sign with the repeated challenge to remember, noting the severity of punishment and warning and the Quran's ease for remembrance
